abstract: OBJECTIVE: Our goal was to evaluate the adequacy of conservative management during pregnancy and labor in women with an ultrasonographically diagnosed ovarian cystic teratoma. STUDY DESIGN: Forty-nine women with ultrasonographically diagnosed ovarian cystic teratoma <6 cm were followed for detection of possible complications through pregnancy and labor. Serial ultrasonographic examinations before pregnancy, during pregnancy, and after delivery were performed to detect changes in the size of the cystic teratoma. RESULTS: In a group of 49 women with dermoid cysts (mean age, 30 years), 68 pregnancies resulted. Of the 68 pregnancies, 4 ended in miscarriages, 1 was electively terminated, and in the remaining 63 pregnancies, a total of 64 healthy infants were delivered. Five patients needed treatment with assisted reproductive techniques. Fifty-five pregnancies ended in normal vaginal deliveries and 8 were delivered by cesarean (cesarean delivery rate of 16%). None of the classical complications attributed to dermoid cysts such as torsion, dystocia, or rupture occurred in the study group. In a follow-up of 56 dermoid cysts throughout pregnancy, cyst size remained unchanged. CONCLUSIONS: Ovarian dermoid cysts <6 cm are not expected to grow during pregnancy or to cause complications in pregnancy and labor.
abstract_ja: 目的：超音波検査で診断された卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫の女性に対し、妊娠および分娩中の保存的管理が妥当かを評価すること。研究デザイン：超音波検査で径6cm未満の卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫と診断された49例を、妊娠および分娩を通じて合併症の有無を追跡した。妊娠前、妊娠中、分娩後に連続的な超音波検査を行い、奇形腫サイズの変化を検出した。結果：卵巣類皮嚢腫の女性49例(平均年齢30歳)で68回の妊娠があった。そのうち4回は流産、1回は人工中絶で、残る63回の妊娠で計64人の健康な乳児が出生した。5例は生殖補助医療を必要とした。55回は経腟分娩、8回は帝王切開で出産された(帝王切開率16%)。捻転、分娩停止、破裂といった類皮嚢腫に典型的な合併症は、研究群で一度も発生しなかった。妊娠中を通じて追跡した56個の類皮嚢腫では、嚢胞サイズは変化しなかった。結論：径6cm未満の卵巣類皮嚢腫は、妊娠中に増大したり、妊娠・分娩の合併症を引き起こしたりすることは想定されない。
